methodology: Union of substantial recurring queer-woman representation and dedicated GL lists. Shows where sapphic narratives are PRIMARY — not secondary, supporting, or subtext in non-GL narratives — are included. Minor/occasional-only entries, reality/competition/documentary programmes, unreleased Thai projects and duplicate seasons were excluded. A verification pass (19 August 2026) removed 19 titles that failed primary-genre criteria and added 9 verified titles across Korea, Japan, Spain and Brazil; three near-duplicate candidate rows from an earlier pass were also merged. The audit's archiveEntries array was resynced with this candidates list so the change actually reaches the published catalogue. The genre is broader than Curslick 04's ending-safe list, so endings and status vary.
